header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Bhoori Bai and others v/s. Province of Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Bhooro Bheel, Advocate
Respondents: Through Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi
body: 1. Learned A.A.G filed of Respondent No 4, District Population Welfare Officer Umerkot taken on record. Copy supplied to other side.

2. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has challenged the decision of dated 25.08.2026 wherein her application for appointment against the post of Family Welfare Assistant was declined on the ground of overage. It is the claim of the Petitioner that a general relaxation of 15 years was applicable to government departments by virtue of notification dated 30.11.2021 as such Petitioner qualified to participate in the competitive process. He therefore prays for allowing this petition.

3. Respondent No 4 in its reply has disputed such assertion and contended that the upper age limit for the job was 30 years and on 08.04.2025, the cut off date for applications, the Petitioner’s age was above 36 years and aged was relaxed for 5 years as per applicable policy for general age relaxation notified by the Government vide notification dated 02.12.2025, therefore, the application was rightly rejected. Learned A.A.G. prays for dismissal of the Petition.

4. Heard arguments. In view of the above factual position, that Petitioner was overage by one year at the time of filing application, her request was rightly declined. Right course available to the petitioner was to approach the concerned department as the matter relating to appointments being purely administrative in nature, are interfered with by this Court sparingly.
5. No case for indulgence of this Court is made out, consequently petition fails and dismissed accordingly.
